ideas.title: Following the Money in the Child Care Reimbursement Program
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the child care reimbursement program and identify any potential areas of fraud.
questions: How are funds allocated in the program?
What are the potential areas of fraud?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financials of the program, we may be able to identify areas where fraud is occurring and track the flow of funds to determine who is benefiting from the program.
